title: My AI coach told me to stop

pip._note: Where your face sits in the twin video, as fractions of the frame. Used to crop the circle bubble shown over full-screen cards.

beats.say: My AI coach just told me to stop training. Eight days before my race.
beats.caption: My AI coach just told me to STOP training. 8 days before my race.

beats.say: Here's the setup. My Garmin and Strava both feed into intervals dot I C U, which turns every ride into fitness, fatigue and form.
beats.caption: Here's the setup. Garmin and Strava both feed into intervals.icu, which turns every ride into fitness, fatigue and form.

beats.say: Then I connected an AI coach to it. It reads my power, heart rate and training load every single day.
beats.caption: Then I connected an AI coach to it. It reads my power, heart rate and training load every single day.

beats.say: This week I rode eleven hours and three hundred and seventy two kilometres. Fitness, seventy seven. Fatigue, one sixteen. Form, minus thirty nine.
beats.caption: This week: 11 hours, 372 km. Fitness 77. Fatigue 116. Form minus 39.

beats.say: The verdict? Reduce load. Prioritise recovery. If I back off now, I start my race on the seventh of November at plus thirteen form. Right in the sweet spot.
beats.caption: The verdict? Reduce load. Prioritise recovery. Back off now and I start race day at +13 form. Right in the sweet spot.

beats.say: And the work is paying off. My one hour power is up ten percent in three months.
beats.caption: And the work is paying off. My 1-hour power is up 10% in three months.

beats.say: Garmin, Strava, intervals, and an AI coach on top. Comment COACH and I'll send you my exact setup.
beats.caption: Garmin + Strava + intervals.icu + an AI coach. Comment COACH and I'll send you my setup.
